title: Th2-derived IL-4 sustains an EGF-secreting macrophage state in mammary tumors
text: We profiled macrophages in a transplantable mammary tumor model. Interleukin-4 released by Th2 cells drove macrophages toward an alternatively activated state that secreted epidermal growth factor. EGF from these macrophages increased tumor cell migration toward vessels. Depleting Th2 cells reduced the EGF-high macrophage fraction by half.

title: CSF1R inhibition remodels the tumor immune microenvironment
text: A small-molecule CSF1R inhibitor was given to tumor-bearing mice for two weeks. Macrophage numbers fell sharply because blockade of CSF1R induced macrophage death. CD8+ T cell infiltration doubled after treatment. Tumor growth slowed only when the inhibitor was combined with anti-PD-1 antibodies.

title: Fibroblast subsets shape T cell exclusion
text: Single-cell profiling resolved inflammatory and myofibroblastic fibroblast subsets. TGF-beta secreted by myofibroblastic fibroblasts suppressed the proliferation of CD8+ T cells. CXCL12 produced by the same cells attracted tumor cells up the chemokine gradient. The inflammatory subset instead produced IL-6, which promoted tumor cell proliferation.

title: Oxygen gradients and macrophage polarization in spheroids
text: Spheroids larger than 400 micrometres developed a hypoxic core. Hypoxic tumor cells secreted VEGF, and lactate accumulating in the core polarized macrophages toward an M2-like state. Under low oxygen, tumor cell proliferation slowed markedly. Reoxygenation reversed the macrophage phenotype within 48 hours.

title: Interferon-gamma licenses macrophage tumoricidal activity
text: Interferon-gamma from CD8+ T cells pushed macrophages toward a pro-inflammatory, TNF-secreting state. TNF released by these macrophages triggered apoptosis of tumor cells in co-culture. The same interferon signal induced PD-L1 expression in carcinoma cells, creating a negative feedback on T cell activity.

title: Checkpoint signalling limits T cell motility in the tumor nest
text: Intravital imaging followed CD8+ T cells over six hours. Sustained PD-L1 signalling reduced the migration of T cells into the tumor nest. Anti-PD-1 antibodies restored both motility and the killing capacity of exhausted cells. Contact with tumor cells increased T cell proliferation after antigen recognition.

title: Macrophage recruitment to necrotic regions
text: Debris released by dying tumor cells recruited macrophages to the necrotic core. Recruited macrophages secreted IL-10, which dampened the killing activity of CD8+ T cells nearby. CSF-1 produced by tumor cells supported macrophage survival in these regions. The result was a spatially confined immunosuppressive niche.

title: A note on statistical methods for spatial transcriptomics
text: This methods paper compares normalization strategies for probe-based spatial transcriptomics. We discuss count models, batch effects between sections, and the choice of neighbourhood radius. No biological conclusions are drawn. The software is released under an open-source licence.
